title: Oxford University Is Older Than the Aztec Empire

scenes.text: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
Teaching at Oxford was already happening in the year 1096.
The Aztecs didn't found their capital city, Tenochtitlan, until 1325.
That's a gap of more than two hundred years.
So while students in England were sitting in lectures, the Aztec Empire didn't exist yet.
History isn't a straight line. The past is a lot more tangled than it looks.

description:
Oxford had students in 1096. The Aztec capital Tenochtitlan was founded in 1325, more than two centuries later.
History overlaps in ways school never showed us.
What other timeline fact surprised you?
